scope: one local macOS arm64 host, serial Fork, explicit cap1; existing guest phase marks plus Go observation overlay
application_connections: one per child, retired before Close
recommendation: Prepared filesystem and ready-to-return are small; prioritize server initialization. Continue the separate #88 16/8MiB hypothesis without attributing all initialization to the buffer pool.
limits: Timing callbacks/file publication may alter scheduling; calibration is descriptive, not proof of zero overhead.
Guest clock origins are independent. Only guest duration differences are compared with the containing host interval.
Detailed server-init CPU/wait/buffer attribution and Linux replication are not measured.
Guest FS reader closures are retained in traced result objects until process exit; no RSS conclusion follows.
Tooling/setup exceeded the initial 25-minute estimate; four setup attempts failed before any measurement. No extra primary trials.
